name: AGORA-01 — Lot 7, Block 1, Arroyo Farms Subdivision
source_survey: Cross Texas Land Services, Job 25-50194, boundary survey 01/23/2026 (bearings: Texas Central Zone grid, NAD83)

georeference.method: Survey shape (exact lengths/angles) fitted to the north line of the adjoining 10.424 ac Silva/Vasquez tract (Milam CAD prop 20535388, TxGIO StratMap parcels), which is the south line of Lot 7.
georeference.absolute_accuracy_note: Shape and sizes are exact from the survey. Absolute position is as good as the county parcel data and the satellite photo (typically within a few metres). Confirm on site with phone GPS at the 1/2" iron rods marked CTLS.

corners_latlng.where: NW corner on Solomon line (start of L45)
NE corner at CR 132 (end of L45)
SE corner at CR 132 (end of curve C6)

corners_local_m.note: Metres in the survey grid, x = east, y = north, origin = SW-most / S-most extent. This is the frame for the 1 m and 10 m cells.

features.west: creek (approximate, USGS 2022); seller disclosed the property is partly in a floodplain
